rows.text: Published a post on Morgan's linkedin account. It read: "Launching Halcyon Threshold: Contributing to Safe and Beneficial Superintelligent AI We're likely 2-4 years from transformative AI systems. The decisions made in the next 12-18 months—about safety protocols, governance frameworks, and deployment standards—will be pivotal. Halcyon Threshold will contribute through: • Clear analysis of AI development and risks • Concrete governance proposals • Strategic coordination across stakeholders • Focus on actionable outcomes Just published: → AI Landscape Analysis (November 2026) → International AI Safety Coordination Framework → Why the next two years are critical This isn't about fear—it's about recognizing the opportunity and the risks, and working urgently but thoughtfully to ensure positive outcomes. https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app #AISafety #AIGovernance #ResponsibleAI"
